weapons.Japanese_air_1943_anchor: Use AIRCRAFT_FIELDING_LEDGER + TECH v007. June Efate included Zuisei-late A6M5-ish fighters, D4Y1-C/limited D4Y bomber trial and B6N elements. By Oct, Raiden and Kyofu are material systems; Zuiun delivery has begun but combat presence is not automatic. No Kinsei Zero/A7M/Shiden-kai back-port.
weapons.surface: Improved practical speed robustness, surface fire-control convergence, torpedo repeatability/second-salvo and DC margin are TECH-driven candidates, not generic historical baselines.
weapons.radar: 1943 closed-loop tendency is equipment/training dependent and remains below mature US-style CIC multi-target battle management.
weapons.asw: Layered 1943 ASW may apply where actual equipment/training/air-sea handoff exists.

shipping_scope_caveat: Use explicit ship-days, hull readiness, delivered throughput and assigned lift. Do not use a broad historical shipping total to erase branch-specific attrition/survival or availability constraints.
dependency_notes: Historical-default data is fallback only where no branch-authoritative state exists.
Retained-provisional Q4/1944 files are non-authoritative until synchronized re-adjudication reaches them.
Individual hull fate and ownership changes require an authoritative event/settlement; absence of a historical loss/recapture is not permission to assume it.
Aircraft fielding and seaplane doctrine are explicit runtime ledgers; type existence never substitutes for local frontline readiness/allocation.
maturation_deltas: Japanese high-grade COMSEC and offensive COMINT divergence remains active into 1943.
Japanese surface/torpedo/radar/ASW improvements are modeled through TECH v006 and event-specific readiness, not as a blanket multiplier.
US new carrier regeneration is real by late Aug/Sep, but does not resurrect lost Lexington/Yorktown/Enterprise/Hornet/Saratoga.
Branch geography—especially Japanese Midway/Santo and Japanese military control in New Caledonia—changes US routing, reconnaissance and strike geometry.
By Oct 1943, Raiden and Kyofu are material branch capabilities; Zuiun is at delivery/first-detachment threshold; D4Y/B6N use role/unit readiness clocks; US F6F/new fast-carrier pressure is active.
